messages:
Mia Carter: Kicking off the LumenForge co-marketing plan. Scope: benchmark blog + joint webinar + two short launch posts. Target window: mid-May. Need owners for benchmark writeup, webinar ops, landing page, and lead routing.

Devon Ruiz: I can own the benchmark narrative and the long-form blog. Will need sample workloads and perf numbers from eng-ml. @Anya can you ping them for the runs?

Sam Patel: I'll own webinar ops/registration. Proposed date Tues May 16 10:00am PT (45m + 15m QA). Thoughts?

Anya Li: May 16 looks doable from our side, but I'll confirm with LumenForge marketing. We should lock the agenda (1x demo, 1x case brief, panel q&a). Also need a moderator.

Leo (growth-bizops): Lead routing note — everything from webinar or blog CTA should be flagged source=lumenforge_partner. Segment -> SFDC flow: map utm_campaign and set lead_source = "lumenforge_webinar" for webinar signups. MQL rule proposal: company_size >= 50 OR role in (PM, Eng, DevOps).

Devon Ruiz: Great. For benchmark I want to show throughput/cost comparison vs baseline and one optimization tip (caching + quantization). Target deliverables: 800-1200 word post, 3 charts, replication script. Deadline request: Apr 28 for first draft.

deploy-bot: Assets uploaded: /shared/partners/lumenforge/ (logo pack, slide template v1, partner bio).

Mia Carter: Awesome — Devon please use the slide template for the benchmark deck. @Sam please create the webinar registration form and add the joint contact consent checkbox per legal.

Sam Patel: Will do. Form fields: name, work email, company, company size, role, use case, consent checkbox. Also capture utm params. Adding honeypot field to reduce spam.

Leo (growth-bizops): Quick snippet for routing rules (put in team ops doc):
if event == "webinar_signup" and source == "lumenforge":
  set lead.source = "lumenforge_webinar"
  assign.owner = "Growth:Sam"
  enqueue -> nurture_journey:lumenforge_01

Anya Li: I'll draft the co-branded landing page copy. Need final partner logo and a 2-sentence partner blurb from LumenForge. @Mia can you get the partner contact to send the blurb?

Mia Carter: Yep, pinged LumenForge rep (elaine@lumenforge) — asked for logo variants and a partner blurb.

Devon Ruiz: For messaging, I'll prepare 3 headline options and 2 angle variants (tech-first vs business outcome). Posting drafts in the content channel by Apr 24 for quick iteration.

Sam Patel: Ops checklist items: registration page, reminder cadence (48h, 2h), calendar invites, recording host, and follow-up nurture. Who owns the follow-up emails?

Leo (growth-bizops): Growth will own the nurture sequence but want marketing to approve copy. Plan: 3 emails (thank-you/recording, brief summary + benchmark highlights, product trial offer). Add SFDC campaign = "LF_May23_Webinar".

Mia Carter: Legal already approved joint outreach but requires explicit opt-in. Please keep copy compliant.

Sam Patel: Calendar invite drafted and tentative speakers confirmed. Added to shared calendar (placeholder).

Anya Li: Quick note — webinar needs a short 2-slide demo checklist for LumenForge engineers (env vars, sample dataset). Devon, can you include reproduction snippet in the blog repo?

Devon Ruiz: Yes, will include a small reproducibility script and link to repo in the post.

Mia Carter: Next sync: Wed Apr 17 2:00pm PT, 30m. Agenda: assets status, draft review, lead routing QA.

Sam Patel: Added to calendar. :thumbsup: 

Leo (growth-bizops): I'll set up the Segment -> SFDC test workspace this week and share test creds in the ops doc.

Mia Carter: Thanks all — double-check deadlines: Devon draft Apr 28, landing copy Apr 24, webinar ops ready May 8, lead routing test by May 1. Ping me if anything slips. :rocket:
